title: Identification and estimation for matrix time series CP-factor models
abstract: arXiv:2410.05634v4 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We propose a new method for identifying and estimating the CP-factor models for matrix time series. Unlike the generalized eigenanalysis-based method of Chang et al. (2023) for which the convergence rates of the associated estimators may suffer from small eigengaps as the asymptotic theory is based on some matrix perturbation analysis, the proposed new method enjoys faster convergence rates which are free from any eigengaps. It achieves this by turning the problem into a joint diagonalization of several matrices whose elements are determined by a basis of a linear system, and by choosing the basis carefully to avoid near co-linearity (see Proposition 5 and Section 4.3). Furthermore, unlike the generalized eigenanalysis-based method which requires the two factor loading matrices to be full-ranked, the proposed new method can handle rank-deficient factor loading matrices. translated_title: 矩阵时间序列CP因子模型的识别与估计
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种新的方法用于矩阵时间序列CP因子模型的识别与估计。与Chang等人（2023）基于广义特征分析的方法不同——该方法的渐近理论基于矩阵摄动分析，其估计量的收敛速度可能因较小的特征值间隙而受到影响——本文提出的新方法具有更快的收敛速度，且不受任何特征值间隙的影响。该方法通过将问题转化为对若干矩阵的联合对角化来实现，这些矩阵的元素由一个线性系统的一组基确定，并通过精心选择该组基来避免近似共线性（见命题5和第4.3节）。此外，与广义特征分析方法要求两个因子载荷矩阵必须满秩不同，新方法能够处理秩亏的因子载荷矩阵。文章通过模拟数据和真实矩阵时间序列数据进行了示例说明。
tldr: 本文提出一种新的矩阵时间序列CP因子模型识别与估计方法，通过将问题转化为矩阵联合对角化，实现了不受特征值间隙限制的更快收敛速度，并能处理秩亏的因子载荷矩阵。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a new identification and estimation method for matrix time series CP-factor models that achieves faster eigengap-free convergence rates by reformulating the problem as a joint diagonalization of matrices, and can handle rank-deficient factor loading matrices.
